- `EARLY`: < 5 min (300 s)
- `MID`: 5–15 min (300–900 s)
- `LATE`: > 15 min (900 s)

Builds on the existing match_time_seconds infrastructure (`a356019`) and the MatchHUD `_paint()` model path (same `f90a72a` discipline as the time / selected-count labels).
